title: Lie algebroid Connections, Moduli of $\mathcal{L}$--twisted Principal Objects and motives
summary: Let \(X\) be an irreducible smooth complex projective variety, and let \(G\) be a connected reductive linear algebraic group over \(\mathbb{C}\). In this paper, we first classify integrable transitive algebraic Lie algebroids on $X$. We then introduce Higgs bundles associated to a Lie algebroid and study their moduli spaces.
